name: comp-383
title: Avatar Notification Feed
blurb: Notification bell with popover list showing user avatars and activity timeline.
description: Bell icon button with unread badge, opens Popover showing notification list with user avatars, actions, timestamps, Mark all as read button, and unread indicators.
use_when: You need a visual notification center with user context (avatars) for activity feeds.
avoid_when: For text-only notifications; use comp-382 without avatars instead.
a11y: Bell button has aria-label. Notification items are keyboard-clickable buttons with text content.
